title: Flip Galleries, Depth Bento, Liquid Metal, Light Rays & Dotted Maps
description: Five live drops: a FLIP-transition photo gallery, a Z-axis bento drill-down, chrome-liquid typography, cursor-bent volumetric light rays, and a pulsing dotted network map.

drops.title: Flip Gallery Sweep
drops.description: An infinite parallax photo track — drag to browse, tap a card and it FLIPs into a full-screen frame with matched geometry.
drops.concept: Reimplements the classic FLIP (First-Last-Invert-Play) technique by hand with the Web Animations API instead of GSAP: a card's start rect is captured, an end rect computed, and the delta transform animated to identity for a seamless expand/collapse.
drops.source: Codrops — "Building an Infinite GSAP Scroll Gallery with Parallax and Flip Transitions"

interaction.mouse: Drag to scroll, click a card to expand fullscreen
interaction.click: Click a card, click ✕ or the scrim to close
interaction.touch: Drag to browse, tap a card to expand

drops.title: Bento Depth Stack
drops.description: A bento grid that drills down in 3D — tap a tile and the rest of the board recedes into soft, blurred depth behind it.
drops.concept: Follows 2026's "bento evolution" toward Z-axis layering: a CSS 3D-transform perspective wrapper pushes unselected tiles backward with blur and dimming while the active tile lifts forward into a detail view, instead of a flat modal overlay.
drops.source: Mockuuups Studio — "Best Bento Grid Design Examples [2026]"

interaction.mouse: Click a tile to drill in, click ✕ or the scrim to return
interaction.touch: Tap a tile to drill in

drops.title: Liquid Metal Type
drops.description: Three headlines rendered as rippling chrome — a moving reflective sweep and a liquid wobble that follows your cursor.
drops.concept: A pure Canvas 2D take on the 2026 "liquid metal" design trend: text is sliced into thin horizontal strips redrawn with a sine-wave offset for the liquid wobble, then a moving chrome gradient is composited with source-atop plus an additive specular sweep for the shine.

interaction.mouse: Move across the type to steer the ripple and reflection
interaction.touch: Drag across the type on mobile

drops.title: Volumetric Light Rays
drops.description: Three glowing beacons cast shafts of light that flicker and bend toward your cursor like dust catching a beam.
drops.concept: Reimplements Magic UI's ambient "Light Rays" background effect as an interactive micro-interaction: each panel casts additively-blended gradient beams from a source point, and hovering pulls the beam spread and brightness toward the cursor.

interaction.mouse: Hover a panel to bend the rays toward the cursor
interaction.touch: Touch a panel to bend the rays

drops.title: Dotted Network Map
drops.description: A procedurally-dotted world of pulsing nodes and flowing arc connections — click a route or a node to spotlight it.
drops.concept: Reimplements Aceternity's popular "World Map" component from scratch without any map data: a dot grid is masked by procedural blob silhouettes, cities sit inside the blobs, and quadratic-bezier arcs carry animated pulses between them.

interaction.mouse: Hover a node for its label, click a node or route to spotlight it
interaction.click: Click any route in the list or any node
